answer: Re-attestations are stored in atlas and pearl lists each lapse. A farm cannot self-supply those because the attesters must be independent on the delta graph. Standing lapses unless 5 peers re-attest it every 11 epochs, so holding a position requires ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 1359 impostors cost 1877 times the honest price and take 18 times as long to clear. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
